osaka_teppan_grill_r_shinmachi.notes: [Teppanyaki · seafood and steak courses at the counter, Shinmachi] A second-floor teppanyaki counter two minutes from Yotsubashi Station where seafood gets as much attention as the beef. A reviewer believes it is run by a couple. Courses are priced by the seafood you pick: diners describe sashimi such as itoyori or fatty sea bream with white soy and ginger, lobster in a rich Américaine sauce and abalone cooked in front of you, with a whisky flambé for show; the top course ends on a tender Chateaubriand that one diner ate with just salt, then garlic rice and a gentle white-miso fish soup. Platters are shown before cooking, and each abalone order comes with a decorated shell to take home. Wide wine list. Counter seats are course-only; lunch must be booked online three days ahead. Closed Mondays and two more days a month.

chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki steak and seafood restaurant (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews). A reviewer believes it is run by a couple (January 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Lobster and abalone teppanyaki; Chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: "I had the Chateaubriand this time, which was tender and flavorful, and it was so good that I enjoyed it with just salt. The garlic rice served at the end was simple yet satisfying…" — October 2025.
"Later, I found out that for each abalone ordered, you receive a sparkling, decorated abalone as a gift from a separate case." — May 2026.

osaka_hana_usagi_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: shrimp and chicken tempura, dashi-based sauce and miso soup, fish dishes.

Courses must be booked by the day before; same-day cancellations are charged in full (Tabelog). ¥550 per person charge for à la carte diners only (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Pay first at lunch (July 2025). 10 seats: 6 at the counter, one table for 4; smoking allowed (Tabelog).
osaka_hana_usagi_minamisenba.notes: [Japanese · tempura bowls at lunch and seasonal courses at night, Minami-Senba] A cozy 10-seat Japanese restaurant hidden at the back of a building just off Shinsaibashi-suji. The shop says it is run by a couple both born in the Year of the Rabbit. Weekday lunch is a short run of tempura bowls and set meals, from a ¥700 tempura bowl to a two-shrimp special bowl (¥1,000) with a light batter and a dashi-rich Kansai-style sauce; rice can be made large for free, miso soup comes alongside, and you pay first. Lunch ends when the rice runs out, and one diner saw it fill up soon after noon. At night it becomes a place for seasonal Japanese courses built on fish bought at Kuromon Market, with a good sake list; one diner was served a warming sake-lees soup on a cold night. Courses need booking by the day before; à la carte diners pay a ¥550 charge. Smoking is allowed. Closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Japanese restaurant serving tempura lunches and seasonal courses (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). The shop says it is run by a couple both born in the Year of the Rabbit (Tabelog listing).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Japanese cooking with fish selected at Kuromon Market (Tabelog listing).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura bowls; seasonal courses.

anecdotes.text: "The tempura had a light batter that was moist from the oil. The sauce had a refreshing, dashi-rich flavor typical of Kansai cuisine." — January 2026, Special Tempura Rice Bowl A ¥1,000.

"From the counter seats, I could see that each piece was being fried with care. The tempura was light, and the dipping sauce was a refreshing sweet flavor…" — June 2025, Hana Usagi Tempura Rice Bowl ¥700.

osaka_teppanyaki_oribe_shinmachi.notes: [Teppanyaki · French-leaning teppanyaki that ends in okonomiyaki, Yotsubashi] A calm, wood-toned counter near Yotsubashi Station that cooks teppanyaki with French technique and still finishes the Osaka way, with okonomiyaki. You order à la carte and dishes arrive course-style: pork rillettes with red cabbage, lobster and scallops with salted onion mousse and lobster consommé jelly (¥3,960), the signature cabbage steak under a Gorgonzola sauce (mop it up with baguette), cod milt with Shimonita leeks, a 100 g Black Wagyu sirloin cap steak, then garlic rice or a mixed seafood okonomiyaki. Portions suit two, and one pair of diners was allowed to take leftovers home. Run by a couple, so service can be slow; one diner felt pressed to order a full run from appetizer to dessert. Book ahead; ¥550 appetizer charge; JCB or AMEX only.

chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki and okonomiyaki restaurant using French techniques (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). A couple runs it, so service can take a little time (January 2026 review).

osaka_yabu_distillery_restaurant_minamis.notes: [Innovative · seasonal course with whisky pairings, Minami-Senba] An 11-seat counter restaurant run by a whisky distillery, where each course dish comes with a choice of whisky, wine or a non-alcoholic drink, and the staff explain each pairing in detail. The seasonal menu leans on Hyogo produce: finger foods such as red shrimp and sea urchin with yuzu, chilled corn soup with prosciutto, ayu, sea bream grilled with crisp scales, Yabu venison, Tajima-vinegar-aged bluefin, then Tajima beef or duck, and an unexpected finish of Tajima duck ramen in a portion you choose, followed by two desserts that one diner rated at patisserie level. The distillery's own young whisky 'Yabu' is on offer. Sunday lunch was ¥7,800 in August 2026; dinner runs ¥15,000–29,999 with pairings in reviews. Reservations only; no sandals or shorts. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Restaurant of a whisky distillery serving French-innovative courses (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

osaka_nojd_ice_cream_minamihorie.notes: [Sweets · homemade ice cream with sorbets, oat-milk flavors and quiche lunches, Minami-Horie] A bright ice cream café tucked a little off the main road in Minami-Horie, whose name means 'satisfied' in Swedish. The case holds about 14 homemade flavors, and you can taste before you choose: matcha with salted black cocoa cookie, pistachio and caramel walnut, a creamy caramel banana made with oat milk, and seasonal sorbets like mango and cardamom (one diner found the spice faint). Scoops run ¥640–840. It's also a lunch spot: the quiche plate (¥1,950 with a dessert plate) comes with a thick soup and a dill salad, and on Friday and Saturday mornings there's a breakfast plate with rice-flour bread or pancakes and Tanba vegetables (¥1,190). Tabelog lists vegan and gluten-free options; ask at the counter. Closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Homemade ice cream shop and café (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Quality ingredients and methods for treats that are gentle on the body (Tabelog listing).
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade ice cream; quiche plate lunch.

anecdotes.text: "I was curious about the oat milk. Thanks to the caramel and banana, it had a rich, creamy milk flavor that was surprisingly good." — 2026, dessert plate with the quiche lunch.
"The matcha flavor was rich and aromatic, and the slight bitterness and saltiness of the salted black cocoa cookie provided a nice contrast." — June 2026, 2 scoops ¥790.

osaka_hot_cross_minamihorie.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 8:00–19:30; closed Tuesday (open if Tuesday is a holiday, then closed the next day) and over New Year; may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 16 eat-in seats; eat-in requires a drink order (June 2026); non-smoking; takeout (Tabelog). Breakfast and sandwich menus (August 2026). A sister shop is in Kita-Horie (June 2026).
osaka_hot_cross_minamihorie.notes: [Bakery café · curry bread and a curry cabbage dog, Minami-Horie] A friendly, unpretentious bakery with an eat-in café on a stylish Minami-Horie street, known for its curry breads. The crispy minced-meat curry bread looks ordinary until you bite into a filling closer to a minced cutlet; there's an egg curry bread too, and the curry cabbage dog piles curry-spiced cabbage around a sausage. A curry lunch is served, and the shelves hold breads like mixed nuts (¥268), cheese fromage (¥328), bacon French bread and anpan, plus sandwiches and a breakfast menu from 8 am. Eating in requires a drink; the coffee gets praise. One diner found prices have crept up. Closed Tuesdays.

chef_bio.background: Bakery café with a sister shop in Kita-Horie (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Curry bread; curry cabbage dog.

anecdotes.text: "It has a unique flavor and texture that combines the essence of curry bread and minced cutlet, making it a one-of-a-kind experience." — June 2026, Crispy Minced Curry.
"The mixed nuts bread has a crumbly, soft texture and is sweet and delicious. There are plenty of nuts in it!" — August 2026, Mixed Nuts ¥268.

osaka_katachi_cafe_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the food is thick toast, pizza, cheesecake and canelés.
osaka_katachi_cafe_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: salmon and cream-cheese toast, cheesecake, vanilla ice cream; no vegan statement. Black coffee and iced tea are the plant-only orders.
osaka_katachi_cafe_minamisenba.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), holidays included; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; pay at the counter first, then take a free seat (Tabelog; July 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), iD, QUICPay and QR payments (Tabelog). 12 seats: window counter and tables, plus a terrace where smoking is allowed; non-smoking inside; pets welcome on the terrace; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). Opened 5 November 2018 (Tabelog).
osaka_katachi_cafe_minamisenba.notes: [Café · Minami-Senba, open until 10 pm with a dog-friendly terrace] A stylish café between Honmachi and Shinsaibashi that sells goods (brand-name bags and wallets) alongside coffee, and stays open until 10 pm every day. You pay at the counter, then pick a seat by the window, at a table or on the terrace, where dogs are welcome. Diners praise the light-roast coffee for its clean acidity, the black-sesame cheesecake for its looks and its taste, and the thick toast piled with smoked salmon and cream cheese (¥1,350 with a drink), so full it has to be eaten in big bites. There's a pizza set at lunch, canelés, and a small vanilla ice cream named after Buru-mi, the café's French bulldog mascot. The listing's website link is dead (2026).

chef_bio.background: Café that opened on 5 November 2018 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Light-roast coffee; salmon cream-cheese toast; black-sesame cheesecake.

anecdotes.text: "The thick toast is piled high with smoked salmon. I tried to cut it with a knife, but there was so much filling that it didn't cut well, so I ended up taking a big bite instead." — July 2026, Salmon Cream Cheese Toast drink set ¥1,350.
"Buru-mi's special vanilla ice cream (named after the cafe's French Bulldog mascot, Buru-mi)" — October 2026, lunch on the terrace.

osaka_melt_chocolate_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Ask. No ingredient list or vegan statement; nama chocolate is usually made with cream, so check before ordering.

Popular flavors can sell out by the evening: one diner found only one nama chocolate left at about 18:30 on a weekday (October 2026).
osaka_melt_chocolate_minamisenba.notes: [Chocolate stand · Minami-Senba, two cocoa drinks and nama chocolate] A dim, chocolate-scented little shop behind a black frontage; look for the cacao artwork. The drink menu is just two items, hot cocoa (¥850) and iced cocoa (¥900), each crowned with a disc of chocolate that melts into the cup, and diners single out that topping as the best part. The case holds nama chocolate in several shapes and flavors (classic, 60% cacao, pistachio, coffee), each piece about 5 cm across, to eat in or take home. Weekday afternoons bring a steady line at the register, and the popular flavors can be gone by early evening. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Chocolate specialty shop with eat-in seating (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Iced and hot cocoa topped with melting chocolate; nama chocolate.

osaka_le_pineau_kitahorie.gf_detail: No gluten information; the range is cakes, tarts (a pie-crust strawberry tart), cream puffs, cookies and toast morning sets, all wheat-based. Only the panna cotta and cup ice cream might be wheat-free — ask.
osaka_le_pineau_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fresh cream, egg and dairy across the cakes, cream puffs, pudding and panna cotta; no vegan statement.
osaka_le_pineau_kitahorie.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–20:00; closed New Year's Day; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Café use requires one drink per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC cards, iD, PayPay, d Barai and au PAY (Tabelog). 9 café seats; non-smoking; children welcome; takeout (Tabelog). Lines form at Christmas and Halloween (Tabelog; November 2024 review).
osaka_le_pineau_kitahorie.notes: [Patisserie · Kita-Horie, the flagship of an Osaka cake house] A neighborhood cake shop near Nishi-Ohashi Station, Tabelog Sweets WEST Top 100 in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026, and the flagship (本店) of four LE PINEAU shops, all in Osaka. Regulars come back for fair prices and generous sizes: a Mont Blanc dense with chopped chestnut, the layered classic chocolat, Gâteau Fraise, a strawberry tart on pie crust, cream puffs with milky cream, and mini soufflé cakes (fromage, and a chocolate one almost like nama chocolate). Cookies are sold singly, including a bitter 60%-cacao chocolate cookie (¥270). The small café next to the shop serves morning sets of avocado or tuna-and-cheese toast and asks for one drink each; payment can be combined with shop purchases. Expect lines at Halloween and Christmas. A regular noted the shop's 32nd anniversary in April 2023.

chef_bio.background: Patisserie that calls itself Osaka-born; four shops (Kita-Horie flagship, Tamatsukuri, Umeda Hanshin, Umekita Green Place) per the official site; Tabelog Sweets WEST Top 100 in 2020, 2022, 2023 and 2026 (Tabelog). A regular marked its 32nd anniversary in April 2023 (Tabelog review).
chef_bio.specialty: Mont Blanc; classic chocolat; soufflé cakes; cream puffs.

anecdotes.text: "The Mont Blanc features a strong flavor of chestnut cream complemented by finely chopped chestnuts, while the lightness of the whipped cream and sponge cake creates a perfectly balanced taste." — October 2026.
"The soufflé chocolate has a slightly gooey texture reminiscent of fresh chocolate, and it's incredibly rich." — October 2026.

osaka_sosaku_kushikatsu_bouya_tetsu.gf_detail: Not GF: kushikatsu is breaded and deep-fried, and the courses are all skewers.
osaka_sosaku_kushikatsu_bouya_tetsu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses are mostly meat and seafood skewers (wagyu, pork tenderloin, shrimp, pike conger, Spanish mackerel); one skewer is dipped in broth.
osaka_sosaku_kushikatsu_bouya_tetsu.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations and same-day walk-ins both welcome (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, tables for 4 and 2; heated tobacco only in a designated area; school-age children welcome (Tabelog). Opened 22 March 2023 (Tabelog). The kitchen makes sauces from vegetable trimmings (Tabelog, shop-provided).
osaka_sosaku_kushikatsu_bouya_tetsu.notes: [Kushikatsu · Minami-Senba, creative skewer courses] A calm, tucked-away counter near Shinsaibashi where the menu is essentially three skewer courses (8, 12 or 15 pieces) or an omakase that runs until you call a stop. The ¥3,980 course of 12 skewers comes with a glass of wine and moves through shrimp wrapped in shiso, wagyu, squid with okra and sea-urchin sauce, taro coated in rice crackers, pike conger with plum sauce, octopus and cheese wrapped in yuba and dipped in broth, and pork tenderloin with mustard sauce. Skewers are fried two at a time and handed over hot. Diners like the seasonal ingredients; one found it closer to standard kushikatsu than the 'creative' name suggests. Walk-ins are welcome; closed Wednesdays.

chef_bio.background: Kushikatsu restaurant that opened on 22 March 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sauces made from vegetable trimmings to cut food waste (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Octopus and cheese in yuba; pork tenderloin with mustard sauce.

anecdotes.text: "My favorites are the pork tenderloin with mustard sauce and the octopus and cheese wrapped in yuba, which you dip in broth." — October 2026.
"They offered a lot of seasonal ingredients, which were fresh and delightful. The service was quick, and everything was delicious." — October 2026.

osaka_annies_diner_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; burgers, flour tortillas (burritos, quesadillas, tacos) and sauces point to wheat. Taco rice and the hamburg-steak plates are the dishes to ask about.
osaka_annies_diner_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steaks, burgers, chicken wings, chili con carne, cheese and egg throughout; no vegan statement.
osaka_annies_diner_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:00; Sat 11:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at the counter, one table of 4; smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog; a February 2026 diner went early for that reason). On the 2nd floor; look for the menu board on the street and on the stair landing (Tabelog reviews). Weekday lunch fills and lines form by noon (October 2026 review). Opened 7 February 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_annies_diner_minamisenba.notes: [American diner · Minami-Senba, hamburg-steak lunches and Tex-Mex nights] A second-floor diner done up in retro Americana (dolls, colorful stickers) with a counter and one window table. Lunch is the draw: a hamburg steak where you choose the weight, the sauce and how much rice, with soup, salad and potatoes for about ¥1,000, plus taco rice and a monthly special that one regular (14 visits) comes back for every time — a chashu-and-fried-egg set in October 2026, an eel torotama hamburg in July. Expect a line by noon. Evenings turn Tex-Mex: tacos you squeeze lime over, two-piece beef burritos, a chili-con-carne quesadilla with guacamole and salsa, Buffalo wings with a blue-cheese yogurt dip, and the 'Maximum The Burg', finished at the table with hot cheese. Smoking is allowed at night but not at lunch.

chef_bio.background: American diner with Mexican influences that opened on 7 February 2024 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak; monthly lunch special; tacos and burritos.

anecdotes.text: "This month's limited-time offering is the Unagi Torotama Hamburg, likely due to the Day of the Eel… the hamburger sauce was a sweet soy-based blend that complemented the eel perfectly." — July 2026, 13th visit.
"I was able to choose the weight of the steak and the sauce, and they also asked how much rice I wanted. With rice, soup, salad, and potatoes included, it was around JPY 1000." — December 2025.

osaka_onigiri_zanmai_chuntaro.notes: [Onigiri izakaya · Minami-Senba, a one-person counter at the back of a building] A small izakaya hidden at the back of the Nippo Eco Building, run by one young owner, where the onigiri are the point: soft, gently shaped rice (organic Koshihikari from Okayama) with crisp nori and fillings like egg-yolk miso, mentaiko butter, house tuna mayo, cream-cheese miso and tenmusu. Around them come careful home-style dishes — firefly squid, dashimaki, mackerel grilled with miso, agedashi tofu, and a white miso with dried persimmon one regular calls exceptional — and a list of miso soups, from a sticky 'nebaneba' soup to clam soup with huge clams. Diners mention organic, pesticide-free ingredients and say non-drinkers are just as welcome. The 'one plate' of three small onigiri can only be ordered when the owner isn't busy.

osaka_mapo_tofu_shin_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; mapo tofu, the house chili oil and the four-hour meat sauce are seasoned sauces, and the menu also has xiao long bao, shumai and gyoza in wheat wrappers.

osaka_mapo_tofu_shin_shinmachi.notes: [Mapo tofu · Shinmachi, a café-looking Sichuan bistro with lunch lines] A stylish, café-like front in the Shinmachi office district hides a mapo tofu specialist; at lunch the line tells you you've found it. The house chili oil and a chunky meat sauce simmered for four hours carry two versions: Shin-chan's Mapo Tofu, sweet-spicy with a hint of cinnamon and a numbness that builds slowly (¥1,400 with rice refills, soup and pickled mustard greens), and the hot First Love Mapo Tofu, named for the jolt it gives. There's also a mapo curry. Some diners find the standard heat mild and suggest asking for it spicier. At dinner the mapo comes with an egg yolk to stir in, alongside ebi mayo under crunchy nuts, yodare chicken, xiao long bao and Kurobuta gyoza. Lunch is cash or PayPay only; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Mapo tofu specialist that opened on 2 November 2022 (Tabelog).

osaka_dashidokoro_semba_yamamoto.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the kombu-cured sashimi, dashimaki and dashi chazuke are dashi-based, but soy sauce, miso soup and the chicken tempura set are likely wheat sources.
osaka_dashidokoro_semba_yamamoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the house dashi is kombu with honkarebushi bonito (official site), and the sets center on fish, egg and chicken.
osaka_dashidokoro_semba_yamamoto.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays, holidays and the 2nd and 4th Wednesday (Tabelog). No lunch reservations, and lunch ends when sold out (official site; Tabelog). Dinner reservations accepted; dinner is generally limited to 2 hours (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 11 seats: 5 at the counter, 6 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Lines form before opening at lunch (2026 reviews). Google Maps leads to 小倉屋山本's main store instead; follow the directions on the official site (official site). Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_dashidokoro_semba_yamamoto.notes: [Dashi cooking · Minami-Senba, a hidden old house run by a 170-year-old Osaka company] A small, modern-feeling Japanese restaurant in a renovated old house down a narrow Senba back alley, run by 小倉屋山本, a company with 170 years of history, on the street where it was founded (official site). Everything turns on the dashi: ma-kombu from southern Hokkaido and honkarebushi from Makurazaki. Lunch is the famous part, with a line before opening and no reservations: the kombu-cured gozen (¥1,600) brings three sashimi cured in kombu, a dashimaki diners call the best, kinpira gobo and miso soup, then hot dashi poured over rice and salted kombu for dashi chazuke. A regular on a 14th visit was still seen off by the familiar staff. Dinner is courses and à la carte with seasonal sake. Google Maps points to the company's main store; use the site's directions.

chef_bio.background: Japanese restaurant run by 小倉屋山本, a company with 170 years of history, in a renovated old house on the Senba back alley where the company was founded (official site). Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The essence of dashi cooking rooted in Osaka tradition" — dashi from southern-Hokkaido ma-kombu and Makurazaki honkarebushi (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kombu-cured gozen with dashi chazuke; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: "I poured the dashi over the rice, topped it with salted kombu, and made the ultimate dashi chazuke… the best way to experience the umami of the dashi." — October 2026, Kombu-zime Gozen ¥1,600.

osaka_sushi_kataoka_atsushi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; omakase sushi with soy-marinated tuna, simmered eel, miso soup and an ebi-mayo roll add-on, so ask about soy sauce and glazes when booking.
osaka_sushi_kataoka_atsushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase sushi course of fish and shellfish.
osaka_sushi_kataoka_atsushi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog); bookings through the OMAKASE site or by Instagram DM @atushi.sushi, and diners report waits of about six months (September 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), Rakuten Edy, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 9 seats, 8 at the counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). osaka_sushi_kataoka_atsushi.notes: [Sushi · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, the hard-to-book counter of a young former Shizuku head chef] An unmarked counter at the back of an office building, behind a grey Italian-plaster wall with the name in vertical stainless-steel letters. Kataoka Atsushi led the popular Sushi Shizuku Nagahori branch before opening here in late 2024; bookings filled months ahead before the doors opened, and regulars now wait about six months. Diners describe a dedicated perfectionist who keeps experimenting, notably with several kinds of rice matched to different toppings (red vinegar, firm, on the larger side). The course is almost all nigiri — Akashi sea bream, Nemuro ikura, Otaru saury over matsutake rice, a surprisingly rich Kishiwada sardine — and regulars add the toro-taku roll and the 'adult' ebi-mayo. An apprentice, Kanta, works alongside. One first-timer found the rice too salty; most come back.

chef_bio.background: Previously led the Nagahori branch of Sushi Shizuku in Osaka; went independent in late 2024 (September 2026 review; Tabelog opening date 17 November 2024). Reviewers call the chef young. Works with an apprentice named Kanta (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Several kinds of shari matched to different toppings, changed and refined from visit to visit (October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase nigiri; ebi-mayo and toro-taku rolls.

anecdotes.text: "The use of several types of rice for different toppings is one of the charms of this restaurant. It felt like a new type of rice was served this time that wasn't present during my last visit." — October 2026, sushi course ¥25,000, fifth visit.
"Opened in October 2024, this sushi restaurant 'Kataoka Atsushi' has gained immense popularity, with reservations fully booked for over three months before its opening." — September 2026.

osaka_ryoriten_okuno_nambanaka.notes: [Italian · Nambanaka, playful omakase and natural wine] A tucked-away open-kitchen Italian a few minutes from Nankai Namba that blends regional Italian cooking with Japanese, Chinese and ethnic ideas, and changes the menu daily. Choose an omakase (5, 7 or 8 dishes) or go à la carte: regulars return for the foie gras omelet, a lamb hamburg, handmade pasta with seasonal sauces (Ezo deer, porcini, truffle and pork), red-wine-braised beef cheek, and a baked cheese stuffed with mushrooms and wild boar. The staff sommeliers pour natural wine, red and white by the decanter. One chef cooks, so a full course can take close to three hours. Lunch is omakase only and must be reserved (¥3,500 or ¥5,000).

osaka_sakana_tetsu_nipponbashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; oden broth and doteyaki are usually soy- and miso-seasoned, and the finish is udon.
osaka_sakana_tetsu_nipponbashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden broth is dashi, and the sakana are fish, offal and meat.
osaka_sakana_tetsu_nipponbashi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30, last seating 22:00); closed Sunday, and Sunday–Monday when Monday is a holiday; other irregular closures announced on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; stays may be limited to 2 hours when busy; walk-ins possible right at 17:00 on weekdays, reservations essential later (Tabelog; September 2026 review). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: an L-shaped counter of 10 and one table of 5 (tables for groups of three or more); non-smoking, smoking area outside; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Tabelog Izakaya WEST Top 100 in 2024, 2025 and 2026. Opened 27 February 2010 (Tabelog).
osaka_sakana_tetsu_nipponbashi.notes: [Oden izakaya · Nipponbashi, a back-alley counter and a three-time Tabelog Top 100] An inconspicuous counter in a narrow alley behind Nipponbashi Station, filled with the smell of oden, that has made Tabelog's Izakaya WEST Top 100 in 2024, 2025 and 2026. The oden comes almost kaiseki-style: each piece is warmed to order in a little pot of the deep, rich broth and the broth goes back to the main pot, and the meal ends with udon in that broth. Around it, small carefully made plates — the doteyaki one diner calls the best anywhere, potato salad, lightly dressed roast beef, thick slices of salt-and-vinegar Spanish mackerel. The à la carte board carries no prices, so it's easy to run up a bill. One regular noticed the staff pacing each dish to a slow eater without being asked. Walk in right at 5 pm on a weekday; book for later.

chef_bio.background: Oden and sakana izakaya that opened on 27 February 2010; Tabelog Izakaya WEST Top 100 in 2024, 2025 and 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes that put the ingredients and their match with drink ahead of show (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Oden warmed piece by piece; doteyaki; udon in oden broth.

anecdotes.text: "The broth was transferred to a small pot for heating, ensuring no waste as it was returned to the main pot after heating." — September 2026, oden.

"The person I visited with had a very slow eating pace. The staff noticed this without us saying anything and timed the serving of the next dish perfectly to match our eating speed." — October 2026, second visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒肴哲、大阪市中央区日本橋2-7-27、日本橋駅 (近鉄・堺筋線) から徒歩8分ほど、月〜土17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30、最終入店22:00)、日曜休み、月曜祝日なら日月連休、ほかに不定休あり (インスタで告知)、予約可、混雑時は2時間制、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、15席 (カウンター10、テーブル5×1、テーブルは3名から)、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、車椅子可、食べログ 居酒屋 WEST 百名店 2024・2025・2026、オープン日2010年2月27日。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 日本橋駅裏の細い路地の目立たない店、L字のカウンター、おでんの香り、おでんは小鍋で温めてだしは鍋に戻す、おでん懐石のよう、大根、じゃがいも、玉子、どて焼き、ポテトサラダ、ローストビーフ、厚切りの鰆の刺身、鯛、鱧、イカ、鶏レバー、白子、豆腐、湯葉、タコ、トマトとチーズ、締めはおでんのだしのうどん、薄いグラスのビール、アラカルトに値段の記載なし、食べるのが遅い連れに合わせて料理を出してくれた、平日17時なら予約なしで入れることも。

osaka_soba_daichan_nipponbashi.gf_detail: Ask. Handmade soba from Nagano buckwheat, and a reviewer had juwari (100% buckwheat) soba, but the tsuyu is soy-based and there is tempura; ask which soba is juwari that day.
osaka_soba_daichan_nipponbashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the soba broth is dashi, and the side dishes include beef, squid, clams and shrimp tempura.
osaka_soba_daichan_nipponbashi.hours_raw: Mon and Wed 17:00–23:00; Thu–Sun 11:45–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and the fourth Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call ahead if bringing children (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay per Tabelog; a June 2026 diner says lunch is cash only. 9 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 1 March 2014 (Tabelog).
osaka_soba_daichan_nipponbashi.notes: [Soba · Nipponbashi near NGK, a one-chef counter for lunch soba and evening sake] A clean, calm counter of nine seats where one chef makes the soba in the shop from Nagano buckwheat — thin, pale and springy, with juwari on offer. Lunch (Thursday to Sunday) is zaru with fresh wasabi, oroshi hiyakake or curry soba, with hot, thin-battered shrimp tempura one diner calls perfect; one diner found portions small. Evenings turn into a sake stop: omakase small plates such as marinated firefly squid, grilled sesame tofu in dashi and clams with vinegar miso, a Japanese course with salt-grilled mackerel and chestnut rice, and soba to finish, with shochu cut with sobayu. Lunch is cash only, per a June 2026 diner.

roles: Chef (runs the counter alone, per January and June 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Soba and Japanese restaurant that opened on 1 March 2014 (Tabelog); soba made in-house from Nagano buckwheat (February 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Handmade thin soba; juwari soba; shrimp tempura.

anecdotes.text: "The handmade soba was thin, had a great texture, and was truly delicious with just the right amount of chewiness… the shrimp tempura was amazing! It was freshly fried, hot, with a thin, crispy batter." — June 2026, Zaru (with wasabi) and Oroshi Hiyakake, large size.
"The Ju-wari soba was simple yet delightful. I tried two types: the plain soba and the one with eggplant and myoga." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: だいちゃん、大阪市中央区日本橋2-7-20、近鉄日本橋駅・南海なんば駅から徒歩5分ほど、月・水17:00〜23:00、木〜日11:45〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、火曜と第4月曜休み、予約可、子連れは電話で確認、カード・PayPay可、9席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、オープン日2014年3月1日。口コミ(2026年1月〜9月): 長野県産のそば粉の手打ちそば、細くて白い、十割そば、ざる (わさび)、おろし冷かけ、カレーそば、茄子と茗荷のそば、海老天、とり天、味玉、夜はおまかせの酒肴と和食のコース (牛肉と小松菜、ホタルイカの沖漬け、銀杏の素揚げ、焼き胡麻豆腐、あさりのぬた、塩鯖、蓮根まんじゅう、栗ご飯、西京焼き、牛のしぐれ煮)、そば湯割りの焼酎、料理人ひとりで営業、量は少なめという声、昼は現金のみという声、NGKの前。

osaka_sake_to_sakana_yoshimasa_nipponbas.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; sashimi and salt-grilled fish are the core, but the sets also carry tempura, fried fish, cutlets and simmered fish, so ask about soy sauce and batter.
osaka_sake_to_sakana_yoshimasa_nipponbas.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; sets come with fish and miso soup.
osaka_sake_to_sakana_yoshimasa_nipponbas.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); Sat and holidays 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sunday, and at year-end, New Year and Obon (Tabelog). Dinner ends when ingredients run out; a 2-hour limit may apply when busy; on 30 December courses only (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the owner prefers phone bookings to online ones, and online bookings get a confirmation call (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; May 2026 review). 19 seats: 6 at the counter, 12 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). At lunch, popular items sell out around 12:30, and the grilled fish takes 15 minutes or more (March and August 2026 reviews).
osaka_sake_to_sakana_yoshimasa_nipponbas.notes: [Fish izakaya · Nipponbashi near Kuromon Market, the grilled-fish lunch counter] A slightly hidden ground-floor izakaya set back from Sakaisuji, where the fish comes direct from the source and the sake is the chef's choice. At lunch, people working nearby come for set meals that read like a seasonal fish chart: the ¥1,200 grilled fish set brings a different whole-headed fish each day — kanpachi, renko-dai, yume-kasago, akamuromaji, mako-garei — and one five-time diner keeps coming back just to see which. The ¥1,300 special adds thick-cut sashimi and a fried dish; portions are generous. Grilling is slow (15 minutes or more) and one person cooks, so come at 11:30; popular items sell out by about 12:30. Evenings are for sashimi platters, simmered fish and, in winter, a fish sukiyaki hot pot. Cash only; the owner, whom one diner found a little shy, prefers bookings by phone.

roles: Owner-chef (one person in the kitchen, March 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Fish izakaya that buys fish direct from the source; the chef chooses the sake (Tabelog, shop-provided). The owner prefers analog ways and asks for reservations by phone (Tabelog). One person works the kitchen (March 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh fish from the source; at lunch a different seasonal fish grilled each day instead of the usual mackerel (June–July 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily grilled-fish set with the head; sashimi platter; fish sukiyaki hot pot.

anecdotes.text: "This was my fourth time enjoying grilled fish, and each time it has been a different seasonal catch, complete with the head! … This time, it was 'Yume Kasago'!!!" — July 2026, grilled fish set meal ¥1,200.
"I decided on the Special Colorful Gozen for JPY 1600… The grilled fish was explained to be Renko Tai… The sashimi was thickly cut and looked fantastic." — May 2026, lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒と肴 よしまさ、大阪市中央区日本橋2-8-16 日本橋レジデンス 1F、日本橋駅から徒歩5分、南海なんば駅から徒歩8分、月〜金11:30〜13:30・17:30〜22:30 (フードL.O. 21:30、ドリンクL.O. 22:00)、土・祝17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、年末年始・お盆休み、夜は食材がなくなり次第終了、混雑時は2時間制、予約可 (店主はアナログ派で電話予約を希望、ネット予約には店から確認の電話)、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、19席 (カウンター6、テーブル12)、喫煙可。店の紹介: 産地直送の魚と店主が選ぶ日本酒、刺身の盛り合わせ、寒い時期は魚すき鍋 (2名から)、おまかせ4品3300円・3850円・4400円、魚すき鍋コース4400円・5500円。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年8月): 堺筋沿いのビルの奥、黒門市場の近く、焼魚定食1200円 (毎日ちがう旬の魚、頭つき)、日替わり定食1000円、日替わりスペシャル1300円 (刺身・焼魚・揚げ物)、彩り御膳1600円、ご飯おかわり200円、カンパチ、Renko Tai、カレイ、Yume Kasago、Akamuromaji、Mako-Garei、焼くのに15分以上、厨房はひとり、12時半ごろには売り切れも、夜は刺身の盛り合わせ、魚の煮付け、アワビ焼き、おでん、アジフライ、穴子雑炊、飲み放題、天ぷらが生焼け気味だったという声、少し人見知りの店主、常連と地元の客、現金のみ。

osaka_horie_kushiage_katsushin_kitahorie.gf_detail: The shop says its kushiage can be made gluten-free and that it caters for wheat allergy on request (「小麦アレルギー、グルテンフリーご対応致します。ご希望の方はお声をお掛け下さい。」, shop site). Reviewers (October 2025–September 2026) describe a rice-flour batter fried in rice oil. But a February 2026 diner mentions breadcrumbs, a May 2026 course included a wheat-gluten (nama-fu) skewer, the fryer is not described as separate, and the dips include soy sauce and sauce. Say so when booking and ask how the gluten-free skewers are fried.
osaka_horie_kushiage_katsushin_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Ask. The shop says its kushiage can be made vegetarian (shop site), but vegan is not mentioned; the course mixes seafood and meat, and the dips and the closing chazuke use dashi.
osaka_horie_kushiage_katsushin_kitahorie.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–01:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog; hours may change). The shop site gives 18:00–24:00, last entry 23:00, closed Sunday, and closes early when the day's ingredients run out. Reservations accepted, and diners say they are a must: one person runs the shop and it is usually full (July and August 2026 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and QUICPay; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 10 seats, about six at the counter and one table for four (August 2026 review); non-smoking (Tabelog). Open about ten years: a regular since the opening mentions a 10th-anniversary chateaubriand skewer (July 2026 review).
osaka_horie_kushiage_katsushin_kitahorie.notes: [Kushiage · Kitahorie, a one-person counter of creative skewers in rice flour and rice oil] A ten-seat Horie counter that has turned out creative kushiage for about ten years, with one person doing everything. The shop calls its style halfway between kushikatsu and tempura: market produce in a light rice-flour batter, fried in Wakayama rice oil and finished with a torch, so diners keep eating without feeling heavy. Skewers arrive one by one until you say stop, or in courses of 10 to 20: angel shrimp, wagyu, kisu with crab and mitsuba, Kawachi duck with porcini, a roast-beef-and-foie-gras finale, even an eel chazuke skewer and dessert. A tomato-and-mozzarella salad with hot fried zucchini opens, and the aosa dashi chazuke is a favourite way to finish. Unusually for kushiage, the shop says it can make the skewers gluten-free or vegetarian on request — say so when you book. One November 2025 diner found the batter hard and gritty; a September 2026 diner ranks it No. 1 for skewers.

roles: Owner (runs the shop alone, per July and August 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Creative kushiage counter in Kitahorie, open about ten years (July 2026 review, from a regular since the opening). One person cooks and serves (July and August 2026 reviews); a diner describes the master as having a strong personality (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kushiage halfway between kushikatsu and tempura, from seasonal market produce; 100% rice oil, and gluten-free, wheat-allergy, vegetarian and children's skewers on request (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase creative kushiage; aosa dashi chazuke.

anecdotes.text: "Creative skewers made with rice flour and rice oil. They are simply the best… crispy, light, delicious, and won't leave you feeling heavy." — September 2026.
"I've been coming to this place since it opened 10 years ago. The quality at this price is unbeatable." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト: 大阪堀江 創作串揚げ 勝新、大阪市西区北堀江1-10-2 都市開発ビル 101、18:00〜23:00最終入店・24時閉店、日曜定休、ネタが売り切れ次第終了。串揚げは「串カツ」と「天ぷら」の中間の料理、ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーにも対応、子供用の串揚げあり、その日に市場で仕入れた旬のものの串揚げ、おまかせ串揚げコース (よいところで声をかける、目安10本・15本・20本)、和歌山県の築野 (つの) 米油100%使用、小麦アレルギー・グルテンフリー対応 (希望の人は声をかける)。食べログ: 堀江串揚げ 勝新、四ツ橋駅から113m、月〜土18:00〜翌1:00、日曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX)・QUICPay・QR可、10席、禁煙。口コミ(2025年10月〜2026年9月): 米粉の衣と米油、軽くてもたれない、最後にバーナーで仕上げ、おまかせで好きなところで止める、10・12・13・15・20本のコース、1本300円ほど、最初のサラダと揚げたズッキーニ、天使の海老、和牛ヒレ、キス・カニ・三つ葉、蓮根と大葉の挽肉、トリュフバターのじゃがいも、タコと芽キャベツ、Kawachi の鴨とポルチーニ、つぶ貝と舞茸、ホタルイカと筍、生麩の酢味噌といくら、アワビと菜の花、ローストビーフのフォアグラ巻き、鰻の茶漬け、デザートの串、ごま塩・だし醤油・ソース・レモン、あおさのだし茶漬け、ひとりで営業していていつも満席なので予約は必須、開店から10年の常連、10周年のシャトーブリアンの串、衣が固くてざらついたという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (one-person counter, usually full); mention gluten-free or vegetarian when booking (2026).

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Dips offered: sesame salt, dashi soy sauce, sauce and lemon (February 2026 review); ask which are wheat-free.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Shop: 「小麦アレルギー、グルテンフリーご対応致します。ご希望の方はお声をお掛け下さい。」 (wheat allergy and gluten-free catered for; ask).

osaka_maguro_hiroshi_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the bowls come with wasabi soy sauce and red miso soup, and the evening course includes a tuna burger on a brioche bun and sesame-miso dishes. The shop accepted a no-mayonnaise request made at booking (April 2026), so ask when you reserve.
osaka_maguro_hiroshi_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a tuna specialist; every bowl and course is built on tuna.
osaka_maguro_hiroshi_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and public holidays 11:00–14:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday, plus irregular days (Tabelog). Lunch bowls without reservation; a June 2026 diner found a queue before 11:00. Evening omakase by reservation, now bookable for one person (April 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money (Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay) and PayPay (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking, smoking area outside; children of school age welcome; take-out (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Opened here on 20 January 2026 per Tabelog; reviewers date the opening to February 2026.
osaka_maguro_hiroshi_minamisenba.notes: [Tuna · Minamisenba, a tuna-only counter from bowls at lunch to omakase at night] A modern Japanese counter three minutes from Nagahoribashi with a whole tuna head in the cold case by the door. It grew out of a members-only tuna club and a borrowed-space lunch counter in Tenjinbashisuji 6-chome that sold out its 30 bowls a day, and moved here in early 2026. Lunch is bowls: negitoro with egg yolk and yam, or the popular half-and-half of marinated lean tuna and creamy negitoro over a deep bowl of rice. Evenings are a ¥9,900 tuna omakase — simmered tuna cheek that falls apart, a tuna burger on brioche, nigiri of lean, kama-toro and marinated chu-toro, then hand rolls — with sake matched to each cut. Diners keep mentioning the owner behind the counter: friendly, funny and full of stories about the fish. One August 2026 diner found the hand rolls too alike.

chef_bio.background: Started as a members-only tuna club, "Maguro Kai" (June 2026 review), then ran lunch in a shared (borrowed) space in Tenjinbashisuji 6-chome, limited to 30 servings, with omakase by referral only; opened its own shop in Minamisenba in early 2026 (February and April 2026 reviews; Tabelog opening date 20 January 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Every morning fresh tuna chosen at the market, rare cuts and aged tuna, rice blended to suit the fish, and sake matched to each part (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Tuna bowls; tuna omakase with rare cuts and hand rolls.

anecdotes.text: "The tuna served is aged from a 260kg catch in Kii Katsura… The simmered tuna cheek came with two large chunks… It was tender enough to fall apart with chopsticks." — April 2026, omakase course ¥9,900.
"The owner, who provides interesting descriptions of the flavors, is very friendly! Oh, and by the way, the owner is really entertaining!" — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: まぐろひろし、大阪市中央区南船場2-11-9 チサンマンション心斎橋 104、長堀橋駅から徒歩3分、心斎橋駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝11:00〜14:00・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、日曜休み、不定休あり、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、10席 (カウンター)、貸切可、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、子供可 (小学生から)、テイクアウト、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、英語を話すスタッフ、オープン日2026年1月20日。店の紹介: 和モダンの空間でまぐろを丸ごと、毎朝市場で選ぶ鮮魚、希少部位や熟成まぐろ、ネタに合わせたブレンドのシャリ、部位に合わせる日本酒。口コミ(2026年2月〜10月): Tenjinbashisuji 6-chome の間借り営業から南船場に移転、間借りのころは30食限定、おまかせは紹介制だった、会員制の「Maguro Kai」から始まった、昼はB定食ネギトロ丼2050円 (Yamato (Nebaristar) のトッピング100円)、C定食ハーフ&ハーフ (赤身とネギトロ) 1980円、H定食、赤だし、ご飯は250gほど、11時前から行列、夜はおまかせコース9900円 (おばんざい2品、まぐろバーガー、握り3貫、手巻き、デザート)、しらすの山椒オイル500円、まぐろのほほ肉の煮付け800円、目の裏の身の胡麻味噌和え800円、まぐろのにんにく刺し、つみれ、Nachi-Katsuura の260kgのまぐろを1週間熟成、Oma のまぐろ、カナダのまぐろ、Tanaka Rokujugo などの日本酒、楽しくて話のおもしろい店主、手巻きの味が似ていたという声も。

osaka_teppanyaki_satoriya_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the hamburg steak and steaks come with sauces, and lunch also has tonkatsu, fried chicken and curry, so ask which dishes can be done with salt.
osaka_teppanyaki_satoriya_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a teppanyaki grill built on beef, pork and seafood; even the vegetable dishes use butter, cream and cheese sauces.
osaka_teppanyaki_satoriya_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; same-day cancellations charged (Tabelog). No cards at lunch; cards, e-money and PayPay otherwise, and a September 2026 diner paid by PayPay at lunch (Tabelog). 18 seats, counter and tables; private hire for 11 or more; smoking allowed in the evening, not at lunch; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Call ahead before bringing children (Tabelog). Sister restaurant: Yoshoku-ya Izanagi in Ebisu-cho (Tabelog).
osaka_teppanyaki_satoriya_minamisenba.notes: [Teppanyaki · Minamisenba, a hidden griddle counter for hamburg lunches and wine evenings] Tucked into the back of a building in a quiet Minamisenba alley, past the queue for the ramen shop out front, this calm counter-and-tables grill cooks in front of you. Lunch is busy with people working nearby: a fluffy, juicy teppan hamburg steak with roasted Awaji onions, or tonteki, curry or the weekly special, around ¥1,000 with a big salad and free large rice. In the evening the blackboard turns to the vegetables one regular raves about — a napa cabbage steak that amazed a first-timer, Awaji onions in browned-butter cream — alongside misuji steak, the house hamburg and sukiyaki, with a good sake and wine list. Party courses with all-you-can-drink suit groups; the whole room can be booked for 11 or more.

chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki izakaya in Minamisenba; the shop describes its dishes as cooked by skilled chefs and runs a sister restaurant, Yoshoku-ya Izanagi, in Ebisu-cho (Tabelog, shop-provided). A diner was back after about three years (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: A daily blackboard menu paired with sake; cooking at a counter you can watch (Tabelog, shop-provided). Ingredients from the Kansai region (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Teppan hamburg steak; napa cabbage steak; Awaji onion dishes.

anecdotes.text: "The standout for me was the Napa cabbage steak… The sweetness and aroma were perfectly highlighted, making it a truly unique dish that only this restaurant could offer." — October 2025, fifth or sixth visit.
"The Hamburg Steak lunch was juicy and delicious… For just JPY 1,000, it even comes with a salad." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄板焼きとお酒 sAtori家、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-25 IBC心斎橋east 1F、心斎橋駅から北へ徒歩3分、月〜土11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、当日キャンセルは料金あり、ランチはカード不可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、18席、11名から貸切可、夜は喫煙可・昼は禁煙、Wi-Fiあり、子連れは電話で確認。店の紹介: 心斎橋の路地裏の隠れ家の鉄板焼き、カウンターで目の前で焼く、日替わりの黒板メニューと日本酒、ワインも豊富、アラカルトからコースまで、姉妹店の Yoshoku-ya Izanagi (Ebisu-cho)、ハンバーグのコース5680円 (料理のみ3880円)、創作鉄板焼きコース6180円 (4380円)、交雑牛と淡路島の玉ねぎのすき焼きコース6680円 (4880円)、飲み放題90分。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): ビルの奥、手前のラーメン店の行列、鉄板ハンバーグ、淡路島の玉ねぎのステーキ、トンテキ、とんかつ、牛すじカレー、週替わり (鮭フライ、柚子胡椒の鶏の揚げ物)、昼は900〜1000円でサラダつき、ご飯大盛り無料、夜は白菜のステーキ、淡路島の玉ねぎの焦がしバタークリームソース、白菜のゴーダチーズソース、熊本の赤なすの生姜ソース、燻製大根とクリームチーズ、ミントのピクルス、ミスジのステーキ、黒毛和牛のステーキ、明石のタコの刺身、鴨の生ハムのあぶり、ホタテのブルスケッタ、目玉焼きをのせたポテトサラダ、ヒレカツ、すき焼き、関西の食材、ソースが少し辛かった、ご飯が柔らかかったという声も。

osaka_nats_shokudo_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the lunch plates are built on fried shrimp, cutlets, croquettes and demi-glace or curry sauce, so ask about the hamburg steak and the grated-ponzu option.
osaka_nats_shokudo_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg steak, cutlets, fried shrimp and chicken make up the menu.
osaka_nats_shokudo_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30; Sat 17:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Table reservations only for full meals; at dinner a ¥1,000 charge applies when you only eat (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at an L-shaped counter, two tables of 4; smoking allowed at dinner, no smoking at lunch; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Lunch rice refills cost ¥100 from April 2025 (April 2025 review). Opened 22 April 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_nats_shokudo_minamisenba.notes: [Yoshoku · Minami-Senba, the hamburg-steak lunch hidden at the back of a building] A small Western-style diner tucked deep inside a ground-floor arcade of shops north of Shinsaibashi, announced by a board that asks whether you have ever eaten a truly delicious hamburg steak. It fills up at lunch for the daily plate: a meaty hamburg paired with fried shrimp and a cream croquette, a beef cutlet or juicy chicken-wing kara-age, with the soup of the day (corn chowder, pumpkin) and salad, for about ¥1,000–1,100. The house hamburg is seared crisp in a hot skillet and comes with demi-glace, grated-daikon ponzu, or a beef-tendon curry sauce simmered for a week that, per a September 2026 diner, won a 2013 award for European-style curry. One diner found the hamburg didn't match the board's boast; the daily plate is what most order. Heavy metal plays. At night it becomes a bistro pouring wine and sake. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Yoshoku restaurant and bistro that opened on 22 April 2013; a corporate-member Tabelog listing (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh seafood delivered daily, unusual vegetables bought straight from the wholesale market and rice milled each time, with carefully made sauces; wines and sake chosen to match (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Hamburg steak with fried shrimp and croquettes; beef-tendon curry sauce.

anecdotes.text: "Today's special was a golden trio of Hamburg Steak, Ebi Fry, and a Bite-sized Cutlet, a classic selection from a Western-style restaurant." — March 2025, daily lunch special (the same diner's ninth visit was in August 2026).
"This curry sauce is a European-style curry that has been simmered for a week and won the Ultimate Curry Award 2013 for European-style curry." — September 2026, Nat's Hamburger Steak ¥1,000.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 南船場Nat's食堂、大阪市中央区南船場3-1-7 日宝東心斎橋ビル 1F、心斎橋駅1・2番出口から北へ徒歩6分ほど、月〜金11:30〜14:00・17:30〜22:30、土17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、日曜・祝日休み、席の予約は食事のコースのみ、ディナータイムの食事のみの場合はチャージ料1,000円、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席 (カウンター7、テーブル4×2)、昼は禁煙・夜は喫煙可、貸切20名まで、オープン日2013年4月22日、法人会員の店。店の紹介: 毎日届く鮮魚、市場から直接仕入れる野菜、その都度精米するお米、こだわりのソース、料理に合うワインと日本酒。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年10月): ビルの奥の目立たない洋食店、「本当においしいハンバーグを食べたことがありますか!」の看板、日替わりランチ1000〜1100円 (ハンバーグとエビフライ、クリームコロッケ、牛カツ、一口カツ、白身魚フライ、手羽唐揚げ)、Nat'sハンバーグ1000円は鉄板で、注文を受けてから焼く、デミグラス・牛すじカレーソース・特製おろしポン酢から選ぶ、カレーソースは1週間煮込んだ欧風カレーで2013年のアワード受賞、ハンバーグとアンガス牛カツ1280円、オムライス、トンテキ定食、日替わりスープ (コーンチャウダー、かぼちゃ、じゃがいも)、2025年4月からご飯の大盛り・おかわりは100円、BGMはヘヴィメタル、看板ほどではなかったという声も。

osaka_curry_hashimotoya_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; one chicken curry built on chicken broth, kombu, onions and freshly ground spices, with spiced rice, but no source says whether any flour or soy sauce goes in.
osaka_curry_hashimotoya_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the only dish is a chicken curry on a whole-chicken broth, with an egg, and the rice is cooked with chicken fat.
osaka_curry_hashimotoya_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 11:45–13:30; closed Friday–Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Reopened 8 September 2026 after a break (Tabelog). Numbered tickets are handed out from about 10:05 at the shop: each person in line (up to 4 per representative) chooses a time slot, orders and pays cash on the spot, then returns 5 minutes before the slot (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). October 2026 diners lined up from 9:15–9:55 and were given slots from 10:50 to 12:20; servings run out (one April 2026 diner had ticket 35 of about the last 40). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026 reviews). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables; non-smoking; school-age children welcome (Tabelog). The room is a dimly lit bar at night (October 2026 reviews). Tabelog Award Bronze 2025 and 2026; Tabelog Curry WEST Top 100 2026; rated 4.02.
osaka_curry_hashimotoya_minamisenba.notes: [Curry · Minami-Senba, one clay-pot chicken curry and a morning ticket line] One of Osaka's most sought-after curries, a Tabelog Award Bronze winner in 2025 and 2026, served at lunch Monday to Thursday in a dim room that is a bar at night. There is one dish: chicken curry brought bubbling in a clay pot, with tender chicken, a soft-boiled egg and marinated tomatoes in a thin, soup-like curry that tastes of whole spices ground to order rather than curry powder. A card explains how to eat it: smell it, sip the clear top like soup, eat it with the spiced rice, then tip the rice and onion pickles into the pot and break the egg for a creamy porridge. To eat, queue from about 9:30, take a numbered ticket when they are handed out around 10:05, order and pay cash, and come back at your time slot; the day's servings go by mid-morning. Diners describe a gentle owner and pleasant staff; one found the flavour a little monotonous, and another thought one visit enough.

chef_bio.background: Curry shop with Tabelog Award Bronze in 2025 and 2026 and Tabelog Curry WEST Top 100 in 2026 (Tabelog); reopened on 8 September 2026 (Tabelog). The owner hands out the numbered tickets (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Spices ground fresh for each serving (about 20 whole spices, per an October 2026 review); a guide card for eating the curry in stages.
chef_bio.specialty: Clay-pot "Rich Chicken Curry" with spiced rice.

anecdotes.text: "The interior feels like a 'BAR.' It's dimly lit and calm, with the sound of an electric mill grinding about 20 types of whole spices after each order, filling the air with a fresh and intense aroma of spices." — October 2026, Clay Pot Chicken Curry (mild) ¥1,400.

"There are various suggestions on how to eat, but the owner was very gentle and the staff were all very pleasant… even after waiting in line for so long in the morning, I didn't feel annoyed at all." — October 2026, Rich Chicken Curry, level 1, small rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 橋本屋、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-21、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、月〜木11:45〜13:30、金〜日・祝日休み、2026年9月8日営業再開、整理券の配布は10:05ごろ、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、禁煙、小学生から可、The Tabelog Award 2025・2026 Bronze、食べログ カレー WEST 百名店 2026、評価4.02。口コミ(2025年11月〜2026年10月): 9:15〜9:55ごろから並び、10:05ごろから整理券、代表者1人で4人まで、その場で時間と注文を決めて現金で前払い、時間の5分前に戻る、10:50〜12:20の枠、35番前後で売り切れ、メニューは芳醇チキンカレー1400円だけ、辛さ0〜3、ライス大盛り+100円、チキン増し、玉ねぎのアチャール、土鍋でぐつぐつ、柔らかい鶏肉、半熟卵、トマトのマリネ、さらっとしたスープのようなカレー、注文ごとに電動ミルで約20種のホールスパイスを挽く、Daisendori と2種類の丸鶏、Rausu の昆布、玉ねぎのだし、鶏油と約10種のスパイスと玉ねぎで炊いたごはん、食べ方の指南書 (香り、上澄み、ごはんと、最後にごはんを土鍋に入れて卵を崩しておじや風)、卓上のスパイスミルと花椒、夜はバーになる薄暗い店内、やさしい店主と感じのよいスタッフ、一度で十分、単調という声も。

osaka_izakaya_jubei_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the 12 sauces for the grilled thigh include sweet miso, wasabi soy and curry, and the menu has tonkatsu, chicken katsu, kushikatsu and yakisoba; salt-grilled yakitori is the place to start asking.
osaka_izakaya_jubei_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken izakaya; the lunch sets are chicken or pork with miso soup.
osaka_izakaya_jubei_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat 11:00–14:30; closed Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). Lunch has a line most weekdays, with waits of 10–20 minutes around noon (2025–2026 reviews); lunch bento to take away (April 2026 review; shop site). Reservations accepted; parties of 12 or more by arrangement; private hire up to 20; all-you-can-drink (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a long L-shaped counter and two tables of four at the back (September 2026 review); smoking allowed except at lunch (Tabelog). Opened 21 January 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_izakaya_jubei_minamisenba.notes: [Izakaya · Minami-Senba, the chicken-thigh lunch with twelve sauces] A narrow, retro counter izakaya near Shinsaibashi that draws a line at lunch for a very cheap, hearty set: a whole grilled chicken thigh, skin crackling, laid on cabbage, with two sauces picked from a list of twelve (the garlicky stamina sauce is the favourite), a free raw egg, and refills of rice and miso soup, ¥850. Diners go double or mix it with a cutlet, and finish a second bowl of rice as tamago kake gohan. At night the owner runs the room alone: yakitori from heart to seseri, the same grilled thigh, horumon with ponzu, quick plates of cabbage and kimchi, and a plain salt yakisoba, with local sake. At a busy lunch, one diner had to ask twice for the free egg.

roles: Owner (runs the room alone at dinner, per a September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Izakaya that opened on 21 January 2016; a corporate-member Tabelog listing (Tabelog). The shop site describes a cheap izakaya for office workers, banquets and solo drinkers.
chef_bio.philosophy: Yakitori, kushikatsu and oden as three mainstays, none done by halves (shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled chicken thigh with a choice of 12 sauces; yakitori.

anecdotes.text: "You can also select two sauces from a choice of 12, and I went with the spicy sauce and wasabi soy sauce. Apparently, there's even a triple option." — September 2025, double grilled chicken thigh set.
"The interior features a long L-shaped counter with two tables for four at the back, all managed by the owner alone." — September 2026, dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋 十兵衛、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-1、堺筋本町駅から徒歩5分・心斎橋駅から徒歩7分、月〜金11:00〜14:30・18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、土11:00〜14:30、日曜・祝日休み、予約可、12名以上は相談、貸切20名まで、飲み放題、カード可 (VISA、Master、JCB、AMEX、Diners)、電子マネー・QR不可、20席、昼のみ禁煙、オープン日2016年1月21日、法人会員の店。店のサイト: 本町・心斎橋・南船場の安いうまい居酒屋、焼き鳥 (大山産がいな鶏)・串かつ・おでんの三本柱、宴会、飲み放題、全メニューテイクアウト可、ランチタイムに店頭でお弁当。口コミ(2025年7月〜2026年10月): 平日の昼はいつも行列、もも焼き定食850円、皮はパリッと、キャベツの上に、ダブル・トリプルも、12種類のソースから2つ (スタミナ、塩だれ、辛口、辛口カレー、わさび醤油、甘味噌、ねぎ、生姜、七味と柚子胡椒)、ミックス定食、豚カツ定食、チキンカツ、豚もも、生卵1個無料、ご飯と味噌汁はおかわり自由、卵かけご飯に、テイクアウトのチキンカツ弁当600円 (味噌汁付き)、夜は店主ひとり、長いL字のカウンターと奥に4人のテーブル2つ、焼き鳥 (ハツ、はらみ、ねぎま、やげん軟骨、せせり)、鶏もも一枚焼き、オニオンスライス、やみつきキャベツ、キムチ、なす揚げ、ホルモンポン酢、シンプルな塩焼きそば、地酒、昼は忙しく卵を2回頼んだという声も。

An April 2026 review describes a weekday-evening visit, and the Tabelog budget lists a dinner range, so evening opening may vary; check before going. No reservations (Tabelog). Order by QR code on your phone; English, Simplified Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter, 6 at tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; a step at the entrance, staff help with wheelchairs (Tabelog). Opened 20 September 2025 (Tabelog), on a former ramen shop site (December 2025 review).
osaka_katsudon_chiyomatsu_hideto_shinmac.notes: [Katsu-don · Shinmachi near Yotsubashi, very thick cutlets from a former sumo wrestler] A bright little katsu-don shop opened in September 2025 as a sister shop of Sennichimae's long-queue thick-cut tonkatsu, once called Chiyomatsu and now Osaka Tonkatsu; the shop is run by a former sumo wrestler, and a life-size panel of the wrestler stands inside. The pork is marinated and cooked low and slow before frying, so the thick cutlet is tender and seasoned all the way through, and it sits on a soft egg over the rice instead of being simmered in it, which keeps the crust crisp. Sizes go by weight (200 g regular ¥1,500, 300 g jo ¥2,000), with pork miso soup and a tray of ponzu, mustard and yuzu pepper. Opinions split: many love it, others found the pre-seasoned pork ham-like or too salty, and the miso soup thin. Order on your phone by QR code; English menu.

roles: Former sumo wrestler (runs the shop, per Tabelog and 2025–2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Katsu-don shop that opened on 20 September 2025 (Tabelog); a sister shop of the Sennichimae thick-cut tonkatsu shop once called Chiyomatsu and renamed Osaka Tonkatsu, which also has a stall in the Abeno Hoop dining court (January and March 2026 reviews). A life-size panel of the wrestler stands in the shop (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Thick meat slow-cooked for a tender, juicy, generous bowl; satisfying portions (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Very thick low-temperature katsu-don with egg underneath.

anecdotes.text: "Since this Katsu-don is not topped with a beaten egg, the katsu remains crispy and fresh. You can enjoy the tonkatsu with the accompanying yuzu pepper, mustard, and special sauce to change up the flavors." — April 2026, regular katsu-don ¥1,500.
"The main branch is in Namba, and the name has now changed to 'Osaka Tonkatsu.' I decided to try this new location, which seems to be a sister restaurant." — January 2026, katsu-don regular ¥1,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かつ丼千代松豪仁、大阪市西区新町1-8-24 角屋四ツ橋ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分 (288m)、毎日11:00〜15:00、12月29日〜1月4日休み、予約不可、カード (VISA、Master、JCB)・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、14席 (カウンター8、テーブル6)、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、入口に段差あり (スタッフが手伝う)、英語・簡体字・韓国語メニュー、QRコードで注文、テイクアウト可、オープン日2025年9月20日、法人会員の店。店の紹介: 元力士の極厚かつ丼、5cmの豚カツをとろとろの卵の上にのせる、柚子胡椒・ポン酢・からしで味変、ヒューガルデン。口コミ(2025年12月〜2026年9月): ラーメン店の跡地、元力士の店で等身大のパネル、千日前の極厚とんかつの店 (Chiyomatsu から Osaka Tonkatsu に改名) の姉妹店、特製の液に漬けて低温で火を入れた厚い豚肉、並200g 1500円、上300g 2000円、特上も、豚汁付き、卵でとじないのでカツがサクサク、ポン酢・からし・柚子胡椒・岩塩・ソース、ハムのよう・塩辛い・豚汁が薄いという声も。

osaka_italian_bar_chako_nambanaka.gf_detail: Ask. The shop says it can leave allergen ingredients out on request but cannot guarantee complete removal or prevent cross-contamination; the menu leans on fresh wheat pasta, bruschetta, fried calamari and fries fried in lard.
osaka_italian_bar_chako_nambanaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Wagyu, pork, prosciutto, liver mousse, mussels, sea urchin and cheese run through the menu; even the cover charge is a cheese appetizer.
osaka_italian_bar_chako_nambanaka.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 straight through (à la carte or courses, day drinking welcome, no lunch menu); last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Tuesday and some long weekends (Tabelog). Weekday lunch for reserved groups only (Tabelog). Regular reservations up to 4 people, 5–8 by phone; one drink minimum at dinner; seats may be limited to about 2 h 20 min when busy; cover charge ¥450 (a cheese appetizer), waived with a course (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats: 10 at the counter, 8 at tables, plus standing room; non-smoking, smoking area outside; children welcome (one low seat, the rest high chairs); the shop asks guests not to wear strong perfume (Tabelog). Opened 26 August 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_italian_bar_chako_nambanaka.notes: [Italian bar · Nambanaka, a natural-wine diner south of Namba Parks] A small, warm-wood Italian bar a few minutes south of Namba Parks that opened in 2024; one regular is already on a seventh visit. The order to make is the Aomori mussels steamed in white wine, then a risotto made from the broth; diners rave about the acqua pazza done the same way. Around it: foie gras and prosciutto bruschetta, sea urchin over shredded potato in cream, Wagyu roast steak slow-cooked and finished over charcoal (order it early, it takes time), and fresh pasta finished as Bolognese with chunks of braised Wagyu. Handwritten blackboard specials change with the season, and a few dishes, such as a Rossini, are kept for return visits. Wines are mostly natural, from ¥550 a glass. Weekends run from noon straight through to 23:00 for day drinking. It gets lively, so book.

chef_bio.background: Italian bar and diner that opened on 26 August 2024 (Tabelog); a sommelier picks about 10 wines, mostly natural (Tabelog, shop-provided). Staff described as attentive and kind (September 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Italian-inspired dishes from seasonal ingredients to go with wine, in a relaxed setting; guests are asked to skip strong perfume so the food and wine can be smelled (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Mussels steamed in white wine with risotto from the broth; charcoal-finished Wagyu roast; foie gras and prosciutto bruschetta.

anecdotes.text: "First up was the mussels steamed in white wine. The plump mussels were accompanied by a flavorful broth, and I loved that I could turn the leftover broth into risotto." — September 2026, seventh visit, Today's Recommendations from the blackboard.
"For the finale, we had Bolognese, but instead of ground meat, it was chunks of tender, shredded meat. I was completely moved by this dish." — September 2026, 3-hour free-flow course ¥6,600.

osaka_teppan_saisai_yamaguchi_minamisenb.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Wagyu teppanyaki counter; appetizers include prosciutto, and the meal comes with red miso soup.

Instagram @saisai_yamaguchi (linked in an October 2023 review). Opened 17 January 2019 (Tabelog).
osaka_teppan_saisai_yamaguchi_minamisenb.notes: [Teppanyaki · Minami-Senba, a nine-seat Wagyu counter near Nagahoribashi] A quiet, stylish counter of nine seats wrapped around the teppan, so every seat watches the grilling, with art pieces around the room. The owner-chef grills Black Wagyu (the shop names Yamagata beef) and seasonal vegetables in front of you; diners praise the vegetables as much as the meat, a rich potage served hot or cold, a small assortment of appetizers, and garlic rice to finish, with salt, ponzu or soy sauce for the beef. Lunch is the deal: a Black Wagyu set from ¥3,180, or a limited steak rice bowl. Dinner courses run ¥7,080 to ¥17,000. The service is homey: staff have arranged birthday plates and cakes, lent a shawl to a pregnant guest, and the chef likes to chat after the meal.

chef_bio.background: Teppanyaki counter that opened on 17 January 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a warm, humble owner who grills in front of guests and tells entertaining stories after the meal (October 2023, April 2025 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully chosen beef and vegetables grilled in front of guests; particular about where the vegetables come from (Tabelog, shop-provided; October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Black Wagyu steak; grilled seasonal vegetables; garlic rice.

anecdotes.text: "The star of the meal, the Black Wagyu Top Sirloin, had just the right amount of marbling… allowing me to enjoy it with salt, ponzu, or soy sauce." — March 2026, Black Wagyu Saisai Course ¥7,080.
"Since I was pregnant, a female staff member kindly lent me a shawl when I sat down… The chef grilled the vegetables and meat right in front of us." — July 2025, course.

osaka_restaurant_tsujikawa_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the course builds on dashi and miso, and includes homemade focaccia, a fermented-butter pie and several desserts, so ask when booking.
osaka_restaurant_tsujikawa_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the courses run on fish, shellfish, foie gras and beef, with dashi-based sauces.
osaka_restaurant_tsujikawa_minamisenba.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–22:00; Sat and Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only, online or by phone; same-day seats sometimes available by phone; departure times within two hours of the booking are not accepted (Tabelog). Cash only since 6 July 2026, when the shop's card processor went bankrupt; no split bills; 5% service charge at dinner (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at an L-shaped counter, one table of 4; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). Tabelog Innovative/Creative Top 100, 2025. Opened 21 April 2014 (Tabelog).
osaka_restaurant_tsujikawa_minamisenba.notes: [French-Japanese · Minami-Senba, a couple-run counter for French food you eat with chopsticks] A small counter between Shinsaibashi and Honmachi, open since 2014 and in Tabelog's Innovative 100 for 2025, where French techniques of taking a dish apart and rebuilding it meet Japanese dashi, miso and seasonal fish. The single omakase runs 12 or 13 dishes for ¥14,770 — think a root celery mousse with Ezo abalone and sea urchin, foie gras mousse with persimmon, isaki with burdock and a sea bream dashi foam, a beef fillet main that regulars call the best part, and a grilled matsutake risotto to finish — then five desserts, and you may choose all of them. The homemade focaccia comes with refills; diners warn to pace yourself. A couple runs the room warmly. Weekend lunch is a good-value way in. Pay cash: the card processor went under in July 2026.

roles: Chef (cooks in front of the counter)
chef_bio.background: Opened on 21 April 2014 (Tabelog); Tabelog Innovative/Creative Top 100 in 2025. Run by a couple, per two reviews by the same diner (July 2024, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: French deconstruction and reconstruction applied to Japanese ingredients such as dashi and miso; a seasonal menu changed about eight times a year, easy to eat with chopsticks (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase French-Japanese course; homemade focaccia; five desserts.

anecdotes.text: "The focaccia is tasty, but be careful not to overindulge, as it may prevent you from enjoying the five desserts at the end… The couple running the place provides warm and pleasant service." — September 2026, omakase course, ¥14,770 with service charge.
"Usually, I'm not surprised by the main dish at any course meal, even if it's delicious, but this was shockingly good." — May 2026, roasted domestic beef fillet with pumpkin and balsamic.

osaka_sushi_toyotaka_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the omakase includes soy-marinated tuna, anago with glaze, miso soup and dishes with soy sauce, so ask when booking (the shop adjusts for dislikes told in advance, per a May 2026 review).
osaka_sushi_toyotaka_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an omakase of fish and shellfish, with a bonito-dashi anago shabu-shabu.
osaka_sushi_toyotaka_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00; Tue 18:00–23:00 (Tabelog). The Senba Uraroji site lists 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00). Reservation only (Tabelog); a May 2026 diner booked by phone and paid a deposit through a text-message link. Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Allow about 2.5 hours for the dinner course (July 2026 review). Inside Senba Uraroji, a renovated machiya with several restaurants; the entrance down the alley is easy to miss (Senba Uraroji site; 2026 reviews). Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_toyotaka_minamisenba.notes: [Sushi · Minami-Senba, an alley-end Edomae counter where the drinks are included] At the far end of the Senba Uraroji alley, in a renovated machiya, an eight-seat wooden counter serves what diners call Osaka-style Edomae sushi: fish aged for days, cured with vinegar or kombu, or simmered, on mild red-vinegar rice. The dinner omakase (¥20,000 in summer 2026) includes free-flow drinks, sake among them, so drinkers find it a rare bargain. It runs to about 20 dishes: it opens with a toro-taku hand roll of aged tuna and miso-pickled daikon, peaks with a shabu-shabu of a 700 g Densuke anago, and ends with a sea urchin gunkan stuffed and heaped with urchin, miso soup from the anago broth, and watermelon. Portions are generous; ask for smaller nigiri if needed. The chef is friendly and chats across the counter. Reservation only; budget 2.5 hours.

chef_bio.background: Trained at Edomae sushi restaurants in Tokyo and at sushi shops in Kyoto (August 2026 review); another August 2026 review adds Nagoya and says the chef wanted to be a sushi chef since childhood. Time Out Osaka (July 2022) introduced the shop as Edomae sushi made by a woman sushi chef who had won a Michelin Bib Gourmand; the 2026 reviews read do not say whether the same chef is at the counter. Opened 13 December 2021 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out each fish with Edomae methods — aging, curing with vinegar or kombu, simmering — so each piece is a dish in itself (Tabelog and Senba Uraroji site, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged-fish omakase; Densuke anago shabu-shabu; sea urchin gunkan.

anecdotes.text: "Densuke refers to those over 300g, and this one was 700g… The grated daikon is so good you could drink it!" — July 2026, omakase course with free drinks ¥20,000.
"I was able to enjoy scallops, which I usually dislike, for the first time in my life!" — May 2026, ¥16,000 course.

osaka_italian_konishiya_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; pasta, pizza, garlic toast and gratin run through the courses, and the menu changes daily, so ask when booking.
osaka_italian_konishiya_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, shellfish, prosciutto, cheese, chicken and game meat on the courses and à la carte.
osaka_italian_konishiya_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 18:00–22:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch suspended from April 2026; hours may vary and open days are announced on social media (Tabelog). Seasonal omakase courses ¥6,500, ¥8,000 and ¥10,000, or à la carte (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; often fully booked (July–August 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: 6 at the counter, 10 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside; children welcome (Tabelog). Second floor up a narrow staircase (July 2026 review). Rooibos tea served instead of water (Tabelog). Opened 23 September 2016 (Tabelog).
osaka_italian_konishiya_shinmachi.notes: [Italian · Shinmachi, a ten-year-old upstairs Italian with produce from Tango] A wood-lined second-floor room up a narrow staircase near Nishi-Ohashi, open since 2016, that cooks with fish, organic vegetables and meat sent from Tango, the owner's home region, and changes the menu with each day's delivery. From the counter you can watch the single chef at work; tables suit the courses (¥6,500 to ¥10,000): a September 2026 ¥6,500 course ran from a heart-shaped mousse and tuna with pickles through pizza, pasta with bottarga, grilled shimaaji and a dessert plate of panna cotta, pineapple sorbet and Shine Muscat grapes. À la carte, a four-time diner rates the summer chilled pasta with pesto and myoga above everything; there are also clam pasta and chicken gratin. The owner chooses the wines. It's often full, so book; lunch stopped in April 2026.

chef_bio.background: Italian restaurant that opened on 23 September 2016 (Tabelog); a repeat diner heard it was the tenth anniversary in 2026 (August 2026 review). Fish, organic vegetables and meat come straight from Tango, the owner's home region; the owner chooses the wines (Tabelog, shop-provided). One chef runs the kitchen (July 2026 review). A repeat diner mentions playing with the owner's daughter (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Italian built on the day's ingredients from Tango, so the dishes differ visit to visit (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Chilled pasta; seasonal omakase courses.

anecdotes.text: "Among everything, the cold pasta with pesto was exceptionally delicious! The slightly thinner pasta had a smooth texture, and combined with ingredients like myoga, it had a refreshing summer flavor!" — August 2026, fourth visit.
"When dessert arrived, I honestly expected just a small gelato, but I was astonished by the beautifully crafted dessert that was served." — September 2026, ¥6,500 course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリア料理 小西屋、大阪市西区新町1-23-9 2F、西大橋駅・四ツ橋駅から徒歩3分、月・水〜日18:00〜22:00、火曜休み、2026年4月からランチは休止、営業日はSNSで告知、季節のおまかせコース6500円・8000円・10000円、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、子供可、水の代わりにルイボスティー、オープン日2016年9月23日。店の紹介: オーナーの地元 Tango から直送の鮮魚、有機野菜、肉、仕入れで変わる日替わりのメニュー、オーナーが選ぶワイン、記念日のサプライズ。口コミ(2025年8月〜2026年10月): 10周年、シェフ一人の厨房、4種の魚のカルパッチョ、冷製パスタ (燻製サーモン、海老、shirasu、焼き茄子、トマトのピュレ。ジェノベーゼと myoga)、あさりのパスタ、ミートソース、チキングラタン、ピザ、猪、生ハムとチーズ、岩牡蠣、ウニ、6500円のコース (ハートのムース、マグロとピクルス、ガーリックトースト、からすみのパスタ、shimaajiのグリル、パンナコッタとパイナップルのソルベとシャインマスカット)、Tanba の野菜の盛り合わせ、いつも満席、狭い階段の2階、オーナーの娘さんと遊んだという常連、メニューにないピザを作ってくれた。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; dinner only from April 2026 (2026).
