osaka_okimen_tengan_minamisenba.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Okinawa soba is a wheat noodle.
osaka_okimen_tengan_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: bonito, niboshi and clam broth; pork toppings; Spam in the onigiri.
osaka_okimen_tengan_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and public holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 15:00); closed Sunday and the 2nd and 4th Saturdays; closes early when the soup runs out; other irregular closures, check Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome; easier to get in after 13:00 (Tabelog). English menu with photos (Tabelog). Lines at weekday lunch; staff take orders from the line and the bowl comes soon after sitting (August and October 2026 reviews). Opened 17 April 2024 (Tabelog); a sister shop in Honmachi marked its first anniversary in December 2025 (review).
osaka_okimen_tengan_minamisenba.notes: [Okinawa soba · Minamisenba, a lunch counter with a line of office workers] A ten-seat counter in Minamisenba's office blocks that opened in 2024 as the area's first Okinawa soba specialist, and now often has a line at weekday lunch. The shop takes the broth seriously: katsuobushi and kombu with niboshi, dried clams, two kinds of Okinawan salt and a splash of awamori, poured clear and golden over flat, medium-thick noodles worked out with a noodle factory. Fresh shredded ginger stands in for the usual pickled kind. The big bowl is the Tengan soba (¥1,200), with crisp-grilled three-layer pork and tender salt-simmered cartilage soki; the salt soki soba (¥950) is the everyday order, and one diner on a 71st visit still adds the ¥100 back fat. In summer there's a chilled Churaumi soba. Add a small jushi or a Po-Tama onigiri, and season with koregusu or yuzu kosho from the counter. Lunch only, no cards (PayPay is fine), and it closes when the soup runs out. A second shop runs in Honmachi.

chef_bio.background: Okinawa soba shop that opened on 17 April 2024 as the first Okinawa soba specialist in Minamisenba (Tabelog, shop-provided); the Honmachi branch marked its first anniversary in December 2025 (review). A diner chatted with the owner in July 2024 (review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Serious about broth and noodles: noodles researched with the noodle factory down to blend and size; broth of katsuobushi and kombu with two kinds of Okinawan salt, dried clams and a splash of awamori (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Tengan soba; salt cartilage soki soba.

anecdotes.text: "The broth is light yet rich in umami, and the addition of back fat enhances its deliciousness. The noodles are special flat, medium-thick noodles with a smooth texture…" — October 2026, 71st visit, Tengan Soba ¥1,200 with back fat ¥100.
"The bonito broth was rich and flavorful... and instead of pickled ginger, [the shop] used fresh shredded ginger, which was a nice touch!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 沖縄麺処 天願 南船場本店、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-2 宮本ビル 1F、長堀橋駅から徒歩5分、堺筋本町駅から徒歩10分、月〜土・祝日11:00〜15:00 (L.O. 15:00)、日曜と第2・第4土曜休み、スープがなくなり次第終了、ほかに不定休あり (インスタで確認)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay可、10席 (カウンター)、禁煙、子供・ベビーカー可、13時以降は入りやすい、英語メニューと写真つきメニューあり、オープン日2024年4月17日。店の紹介: 南船場初の沖縄そば専門店、だしと麺にこだわり、製麺所で配合から太さまで研究した麺、かつお節と昆布に沖縄の塩2種と干し貝、awamori を少し、澄んだ黄金色のスープ。口コミ(2024年4月〜2026年10月): Tengan soba 1200円 (三枚肉と塩軟骨の Soki)、塩軟骨の Soki soba 950円、背脂100円、夏限定の冷たい Churaumi soba 980円、Aasa soba、小さい jushi200円とmozuku の酢の物、Po-Tama のおにぎり (スパムと薄焼き卵) ハーフ200円、ランチは150円、平打ちの中太麺、生の千切りしょうが、かまぼこ、結び昆布、卓上のkoregusu と yuzu kosho、平日の昼は会社員の行列、並んでいる間に注文を取る、本町店の1周年 (2025年12月)。

osaka_carne_asaeda_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; tortillas, quesadillas, nachos, salsas and a curry are on the menu, and nothing says which tortillas are corn, so ask.
osaka_carne_asaeda_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef and lamb steaks, chicken, gizzards, chili con carne and cheese throughout.
osaka_carne_asaeda_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, public holidays and the days before and after 18:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30); Sat 15:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00/22:30); Sun 15:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00/21:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; full on an October 2026 night. The shop asks that guests drink alcohol, and no children (heated-tobacco smoking area) (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). Service charge ¥200 per person (Tabelog). 20 seats, 30 standing; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST Top 100, 2026. Opened 22 June 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_carne_asaeda_shinmachi.notes: [Mexican · Shinmachi, a carne-asada izakaya on Tabelog's 2026 ethnic Top 100] A glass-fronted cantina with a big sign and cacti outside, north of Yotsubashi, playing Latin music, that made Tabelog's Asian/Ethnic WEST Top 100 in 2026. The star is the carne asada: lean steak cooked rare, eaten on its own first, then wrapped in a tortilla with chili con carne, jalapeño pickles, mashed potato and fresh salsa. Around it, Mexican-izakaya plates with a Japanese streak: spiced beans with sansho, spicy takuan, shibire chicken in a sansho sauce, chili-cheese quesadilla, pulled-chicken nachos. The October 2026 course (¥7,000 with all-you-can-drink) pairs red-meat and lamb steaks and ends with a curry. One diner found the menu short for a long stay and suggests it as one stop on a crawl. Drinkers only, no children, PayPay rather than cards.

chef_bio.background: Mexican and steak izakaya that opened on 22 June 2021; Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST Top 100, 2026 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Lean-meat steaks, beef and lamb, with a twist on Mexican carne asada; Latin music and tequila for gatherings with friends (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Carne asada with tortillas; quesadillas; nachos.

anecdotes.text: "The slightly rare, juicy red meat steak is grilled to perfection. First, I savored the meat on its own, then wrapped it in a tortilla with chili con carne, jalapeño pickles, mashed potatoes, and fresh salsa." — October 2026, Carne Asada.

"I booked the assorted platter course featuring red meat steak and lamb sirloin cap, along with an all-you-can-drink option for JPY 7000… the curry that came out at the end was rich and delicious." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: CARNE asaeda、大阪市西区新町1-2-5、四ツ橋駅から北へ徒歩5分、心斎橋駅から徒歩6分、月・火・木・金・祝日・祝前日・祝後日18:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、土15:00〜23:00、日15:00〜22:00 (L.O. 料理21:00、ドリンク21:30)、水曜休み、予約可、お酒を飲む方のみ、受動喫煙防止のため子供不可 (加熱式たばこの喫煙スペース)、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay・楽天ペイ可、サービス料200円、20席 (立ち飲み30名)、貸切20名まで、英語メニューあり、食べログ アジア・エスニック WEST 百名店 2026、オープン日2021年6月22日。店の紹介: 牛と羊の赤身ステーキ、看板はカルネアサダ、トルティーヤとオリジナルのサルサとチリコンカン、ラテン音楽、テキーラ、ワカモレ、ナチョス、ケサディーヤ、ドリンク400円から、ステーキ3000円から、コース6000円から。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): 大きな看板とサボテンのガラス張りの店、レアの赤身のカルネアサダとトルティーヤ、チリコンカン、ハラペーニョのピクルス、マッシュポテト、サルサ、sansho のスパイスビーンズ、スパイシーな takuan、sansho のソースのShibire Chicken、エスニックサラダ、チリチーズのケサディーヤ、プルドチキンのナチョス、スパイスの砂肝、ミチェラーダ、カルダモン焼酎、塩のポテトサラダ、赤身と羊のステーキのコース飲み放題つき7000円と締めのカレー、メニューが少なめという声、満席の夜も。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; adults who drink only; PayPay, no cards (2026).

osaka_aochi_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; simmered dishes, teriyaki, saikyo-yaki and soy-sauce glazes are usually soy-seasoned, and there are tempura, kara-age and katsu, so ask.
osaka_aochi_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led Japanese menu built on dashi, with chicken, duck and wagyu.
osaka_aochi_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon 17:00–22:30; Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; Tue–Wed closing since May 2022 per the shop site); closed over the New Year holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and recommended; often full with regulars (January–October 2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 at tables (Tabelog; the shop site says a 9-seat counter and two tables of four); non-smoking; children welcome; BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Opened 12 March 2013 (shop site; Tabelog).
osaka_aochi_shinmachi.notes: [Japanese · Shinmachi by Nishi-Ohashi, a regulars' counter for seasonal small dishes since 2013] A bright, clean Japanese restaurant a few minutes from Nishi-Ohashi Station, open since 2013, which sets out to serve seasonal food in a homely room without fuss. The menu is long and moves with the market: sashimi that one diner calls the highlight, kizushi that won another over at first bite, bamboo shoots simmered in dashi in spring, eggplant in summer, matsutake dobin-mushi in autumn, and plenty of small plates for sake, such as mentaiko with a little karasumi, or a white sesame and celery salad. Finish with the natto zosui, which a first-timer went home wanting to cook. Regulars, many older and local, keep it full, so book; one diner who waited was phoned the moment a table came free. Tabelog puts dinner at about ¥8,000–15,000 a head, plus 10% service.

chef_bio.background: Japanese restaurant that opened on 12 March 2013 (shop site). Diners mention both a chef and an owner (January 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Delicious dishes made with the ingredients of each season, enjoyed casually in a homely atmosphere" (shop site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal sashimi and small dishes; natto zosui.

anecdotes.text: "I made a reservation for 7 PM, and [the shop] called me as soon as a table was available, so I rushed over. The owner apologized for the wait, but honestly, I was grateful for the call!" — May 2026, third visit.
"I was also intrigued by the natto zosui (natto rice porridge) and decided to order it, and it was fantastic! I plan to try making it at home." — January 2026, first visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 店のサイト: 和食の店 青地、四季折々の旬の食材を使った美味しいお料理をアットホームな雰囲気の中で気軽に、2013年3月12日開店、2022年5月から火・水曜定休、カウンター9席と4人掛けテーブル2卓、西大橋交差点よりなにわ筋を北へ二つ目の辻を東へ入った北側、西大橋駅2番出口より徒歩約3分。お料理の例: 明石の天然真鯛造り、千葉県産かつおの造り・叩き、はもの焼霜造り・落とし梅肉、あおりいかの造り、毛ガニ三杯酢、賀茂茄子みょうが煮、れんこんまんじゅう、セロリのぬたあえ、極太アスパラの塩焼、メバルの煮付け、銀だらの西京焼、穴子のかば焼、稚鮎の天ぷら・唐揚、但馬どりの塩焼・唐揚、一口和牛ヒレカツ、納豆ぞうすい、穴子めし、その日の仕入れ状況により価格の変動あり。食べログ: 大阪市西区新町1-30-6 第一合田ビル 1F、月17:00〜22:30、木〜日17:00〜23:00、火・水曜休み、年末年始休み、予約可、カード (VISA、Master) 可、電子マネー・QR不可、サービス料10%、16席 (カウンター8、テーブル8)、禁煙、子供可、持ち込み可、オープン日2013年3月12日。口コミ(2026年1月〜10月): いつも常連でいっぱい、年配の常連も、松茸の dobin-mushi、夏の茄子、shishamo、鶏、筍のだし煮、kizushi、生牡蠣、刺身、karasumi を少し合わせた mentaiko、白ごまとセロリのサラダ、島にんにくを添えた鴨の焼き物、雑炊、納豆ぞうすい、手ごろな季節の天ぷら、日本酒が豊富、席が空いたら電話をくれた、シェフもオーナーも感じがいい、一人8000円〜15000円ほど (食べログ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; Japanese menu, a regulars' room (2026).

osaka_wafu_cafe_haraiso_bakuromachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the daily main is often a fried tofu cutlet or croquette, sides have included macaroni salad, and sauces (sesame, miso, ponzu, ketchup) change with the day.
osaka_wafu_cafe_haraiso_bakuromachi.vegan_detail: Ask. A February 2025 diner found no animal products in that day's set (tofu minced cutlet, tofu, bean sprouts, miso soup, brown-rice onigiri), but the menu changes daily, the miso soup's stock is not stated, and an earlier set included macaroni salad.
osaka_wafu_cafe_haraiso_bakuromachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–19:00; closed Saturday, Sunday and public holidays (Tabelog). An August 2026 diner reports last order at 15:30 for the set meal. Cash only (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 15 seats, counter and tables; smoking allowed except 11:00–15:00 (Tabelog). Up a steep staircase to the 2nd floor, above a Chinese restaurant (February 2025, October 2025 and January 2026 reviews).
osaka_wafu_cafe_haraiso_bakuromachi.notes: [Café · Bakuromachi, a quiet Showa-retro room and one healthy daily set] Up a steep, worn staircase above a flashy Chinese restaurant, a dim, hushed room of antique furniture and soft music where the wall clock is audible and most diners eat alone. There is one lunch: the Inaka (country-style) set, built around a daily tofu dish — a minced cutlet with sesame sauce and grated daikon in January 2026, a fluffy tofu hamburg with daikon and ponzu in June 2026 — with four little sides on a bamboo leaf, chilled tofu, miso soup and plain brown-rice onigiri without nori. Pick one or two onigiri (¥800 or ¥850); a coffee after is ¥50. It fills up just after noon on weekdays. A September 2023 diner saw one person running the whole shop. Cash only.

roles: Owner (ran the shop alone on a September 2023 visit)
chef_bio.background: Japanese-style café serving a daily brown-rice onigiri set since at least 2018 (April 2018 review). A September 2023 diner thought the owner was running the place single-handedly.
chef_bio.specialty: Daily tofu-based Inaka set with brown-rice onigiri.

anecdotes.text: "The meal features a daily main dish along with four side dishes, cold tofu, miso soup, and a rural set meal with brown rice onigiri… Coffee or tea after the meal is available for just JPY 50." — January 2026, Inaka set with tofu minced cutlet.
"The interior is quiet… You can even hear the ticking of the wall clock due to the tranquility." — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和風カフェ はらいそ、大阪市中央区博労町3-3-14 2階、本町駅・心斎橋駅から徒歩8分、月〜金12:00〜19:00、土日祝休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、15席、喫煙可 (11時〜15時は禁煙)。口コミ(2018年4月〜2026年8月): 2階への急な階段、1階は中華料理店、昭和レトロで薄暗く静か、アンティークの家具、黒電話、ひとりの女性客が多い、メニューは日替わりの田舎定食のみ、玄米おにぎりを1個か2個 (800円・850円、2025年1月)、主菜は豆腐のメンチカツ、豆腐ハンバーグ、豆腐と野菜のコロッケなど、笹の葉にのせた小鉢4品、冷奴、味噌汁、海苔のないおにぎり、食後のドリンク50円、2025年2月の客は動物性のものなしと、2023年9月の客は店主がひとりで切り盛りしていると、2026年8月の客によるとラストオーダー15時半、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: One set only, just order lunch and say 1 or 2 onigiri; cash only (2026).

osaka_yakitori_toki_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the course includes soy-marinated quail egg, tare-glazed skewers, a monaka wafer, country bread, and a choice of somen or curry to finish, so ask when booking.
osaka_yakitori_toki_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken omakase course with duck, egg custard and a cheesecake.
osaka_yakitori_toki_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 18:00–22:30; closed Thursday (Tabelog). The official site says closing days are irregular. Two fixed seatings, 18:00 and 20:30, everyone starting together; phone if late, since late arrivals join the course mid-way; no children under 12 (Tabelog). Omakase course only, ¥14,300 tax included (Tabelog), plus a 10% service charge from 1 July 2026 (Tabelog); October 2026 reviews paid ¥15,730. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats by Tabelog; the official site gives a counter of 8 and a private room for 4; non-smoking. Opened 1 October 2025 (Tabelog; official site). Tabelog notes it is unrelated to the other Toki yakitori shops in Higobashi and Namba.
osaka_yakitori_toki_shinmachi.notes: [Yakitori · Shinmachi, an omakase counter that looks like a sushi bar] Nothing outside says yakitori: inside is a quiet room with a coffered ceiling, natural-stone walls and a counter cut from a 200-year-old hinoki, more like a sushi or kaiseki bar. The owner-chef, born in Osaka and shaped by youth spent in Yamagata, trained at a well-known Kitashinchi yakitori restaurant before opening here in October 2025, and grills mainly Yamagata and Hinai jidori over Kishu binchotan, folding in Japanese and French technique. Two seatings a night run one course of about 15 dishes: a pâté de campagne in a monaka shell, a grilled-maitake consommé, skin-on thigh and neck, crunchy gizzard, wings smoked after grilling, truffle-cheese tsukune, a chawanmushi under porcini-and-truffle sauce, then karasumi somen or spiced curry and a pumpkin cheesecake on red bean paste. One diner describes a young grill master who greets and explains each dish, then grills with total focus at the centre of the counter. Pairings run to wine and champagne as well as sake.

chef_bio.origin: Born in Osaka; spent youth in Yamagata (official site).
chef_bio.background: Trained at a well-known yakitori restaurant in Kitashinchi (official site, Japanese page; the English page says Michelin-starred restaurants) before opening Yakitori Toki on 1 October 2025. Reviewers call the grill master young (October 2026). One October 2026 review says a chef from The Ritz-Carlton supervised the curry and the mushroom sauce.
chef_bio.philosophy: Cooking as thanks to people and to the land: ingredients from places tied to the chef's life, vegetables picked by the chef at the market, Japanese and French techniques used to take yakitori beyond its usual form (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase yakitori of Yamagata and Hinai jidori over Kishu binchotan.

anecdotes.text: "The Yamagata chicken is usually raised for about 120 days, but they sometimes extend it to 150-160 days, showing their commitment to the chicken's growing environment." — October 2026, omakase course ¥15,730.
"The chicken wings are bone-in and smoked after grilling, which reduces the fat while enhancing the aroma." — October 2026.

osaka_toiru_cafe_bakuromachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the soft serve comes in a cup or a cone (waffle cone on Hot Pepper), the faces are sugar candy, and scones are on the menu.
osaka_toiru_cafe_bakuromachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dairy soft serve with a rich milk flavour.
osaka_toiru_cafe_bakuromachi.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–20:00, food last order 19:30 (Tabelog); Hot Pepper lists Tuesday as the closing day and soft serve until 19:30 on Mondays, so check Tuesdays. Order at a self-service touch panel (September 2026 reviews). Reservations through Tabelog (August 2026 review). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, UnionPay), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, Alipay (Tabelog). 20 seats (Tabelog; Hot Pepper says 24), sofa seating, wheelchair access, free Wi-Fi, non-smoking (Tabelog). Dogs welcome inside, with a menu for dogs; children and strollers welcome; English, Traditional Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog; Hot Pepper). Opened 27 November 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_toiru_cafe_bakuromachi.notes: [Café · Bakuromachi, soft serve dressed as your favourite dog] A white, wood-trimmed café opened in late 2025 where dogs come in with their owners and the soft serve wears a sugar-candy face of a dog breed: twelve breeds and two cats to choose from on the touch-panel, in a cup or a cone. Diners rate the ice cream itself rich and milky, around ¥690–750 (August 2026), and there are scones, matcha and hojicha drinks, and a menu for the dogs. One August 2026 diner found the faces vary in neatness and the room a little food-court-like; on a Sunday it was packed. Open from 8 am; Tuesday hours conflict between listings.

chef_bio.background: Dog-friendly café that opened on 27 November 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: A break for people walking their dogs, with soft serve designed after dog breeds and meals for dogs (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Dog-breed soft serve.

anecdotes.text: "You can choose from 12 different dog designs for the soft serve, all of which are incredibly cute. There are also 2 cat options available." — September 2026, Maltese vanilla.
"Dog Soft Serve Ice Cream - JPY 750 / Scone - JPY 450" — August 2026.

osaka_rakanka_minamisenba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; the daily mains include herb-and-breadcrumb-crusted fish, saikyo-miso fish and stews, and every set comes with miso soup, so ask which main is wheat-free that day.
osaka_rakanka_minamisenba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: each set is built around a fish or meat main, with miso soup.
osaka_rakanka_minamisenba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00; closed Saturday, Sunday, public holidays and over the New Year (Tabelog). Lunch is a daily set: choose the fish or the meat main (2024–2026 reviews); one April 2026 regular simply orders the omakase set and it arrives. Set meals in the evening too (September 2026 review). Takeaway available (2026 review). Busy just before noon with office workers (April 2026 review). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats with counter seating; no private rooms; whole-shop booking possible (Tabelog). In a narrow alley; small from outside but roomier inside (April 2024 review). The website listed on Tabelog (racanca.com) no longer resolves (checked 2026-10-30).
osaka_rakanka_minamisenba.notes: [Set meals · Minami-Senba, brown-rice health lunches in an office alley] A small counter dining room in a narrow alley of the Minami-Senba office district that has served the same kind of meal for years: a daily choice of fish or meat, two little side dishes, miso soup, fruit and brown rice that the shop advertises as the best in Osaka (per an April 2026 diner) — chewy, fluffy, and to another diner not like brown rice at all. Seasoning is gentle throughout (saikyo-miso Spanish mackerel, basil-grilled mackerel, herb-crusted salmon, a mild mapo tofu), and the health tea changes daily. Lunch is about ¥1,000 and fills up before noon; turnover is quick and takeaway is offered. In the evening the same kitchen serves vegetable-heavy set meals with four or eight side dishes. A January 2026 diner returning after five or six years found the master and partner still there, and a July 2024 diner notes the owner specializes in astrology.

chef_bio.background: Run by the master and a partner; a diner returning in January 2026 after five or six years found both still at the shop (January 2026 review). The owner specializes in astrology (July 2024 review). Offered takeout through Uber during the pandemic (June 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Healthy, gently seasoned set meals that let the ingredients come through, always with brown rice (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily fish or meat set with brown rice.

anecdotes.text: "Now, onto the main topic: this brown rice. It's advertised as the best in Osaka, and I can see why—it's incredibly delicious!" — April 2026, Daily Set A (herb-crusted salmon) ¥1,000.
"I don't ask about the details; it comes out in order automatically… All of this for JPY 900." — April 2026, omakase set meal.

osaka_cafe_mimi_eden_kitahorie.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the café is built around an all-you-can-eat wheat bread buffet (croissants, salt bread, danishes), and no gluten information is given.
osaka_cafe_mimi_eden_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants and danishes, clam chowder, cream pasta, omurice and dairy desserts.
osaka_cafe_mimi_eden_kitahorie.hours_raw: Wed–Mon and public holidays 11:00–17:00 (food last order 16:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bread-buffet lunch 11:00–15:30 (last order 14:30); café 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:00); seating may be limited to 80 minutes (Tabelog; an October 2026 diner was given one hour). Reservations taken; arrive 5–10 minutes early, and a booking more than 15 minutes late is cancelled (Tabelog). Reservations recommended: full at the 11:00 opening on an October 2026 holiday, with some groups sent to the terrace; a weekday diner got in without one (October 2026 reviews). Bread half price after 16:00 to cut food waste (Tabelog, shop-provided). Cards, transport IC, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai (Tabelog). 12 table seats (Tabelog); non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; birthday plates. Opened 7 January 2026 (Tabelog).
osaka_cafe_mimi_eden_kitahorie.notes: [Bread-buffet café · Kitahorie, opened January 2026] A small café with a very cute interior on the ground floor of a Kitahorie apartment building (Halloween-themed in October 2026) where lunch means picking a main — salad, clam chowder, cream pasta or omurice — and adding all-you-can-eat bread. About a dozen breads sit at the buffet, mostly sweet, and croissants and salt bread come out hot every 30 minutes, often brought to the table; diners single those two out. The premium plan adds mini desserts, French toast and fruit sandwiches. Seating is timed (80 minutes per Tabelog) and tight, a few tables went to the terrace on a busy holiday, and after noon some breads run out or dry. Reviews are mostly happy; one diner found ¥2,000 for a salad plus the bread add-on poor value. Bread is half price after 4 pm.

chef_bio.background: Bread-buffet café that opened on 7 January 2026 in the Ajiru Kitahorie apartment building (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Bread sold at half price after 16:00 to reduce food waste (Tabelog, shop-provided).
chef_bio.specialty: Freshly baked croissants and salt bread; bread buffet.

anecdotes.text: "The bread selection included about 15 varieties such as croissants, salt bread, focaccia, apple danish, mango danish, fig danish, matcha croissant… The croissants and salt bread were served fresh twice during my visit." — October 2026, holiday lunch, clam chowder.
"Personally, the freshly baked salt bread and the muscat fruit sandwich were the most delicious!" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service buffet; book ahead for weekends and holidays (2026).
